feeds.title: BGLH Marketplace Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about Beauty, Culture & Natural Hair. Discover insightful beauty tips, Stress management tips, and articles on the latest sales and news from BGLH. Black Girl with Long Hair is a natural hair-turned-beauty and culture website created by and for black women.

feeds.title: Blushing Black
feeds.description: Blushing Black stemmed from a simple idea: to create a beautiful, digital space where I could express my thoughts, showcase creativity and share everything in between. I share content & lifestyle topics that all women could relate to. It turned out to be a safe space where women could feel like were having girl-chat on the sofa or laughing over Sunday brunch.

feeds.title: Black Beauty & Hair
feeds.description: Black Beauty & Hair is the magazine for women of color, featuring makeovers, celebrity looks, and expert tips to empower your beauty journey today!

feeds.title: Sadiaa Black Beauty Guide News
feeds.description: Launched in 2017, Sadiaa Black Beauty Guide is a 360-degree Black beauty ecosystem featuring the U.S.' premier searchable directory of Black-owned brands, along with news, resources, interviews, and more.

feeds.title: Beauty In Color
feeds.description: Beauty In Color is a skincare, beauty, and wellness blog from the perspective of a NYC Eczema blogger. The blog provides in-depth reviews on beauty products, offers skincare tips and routines, and gives the ingredients' basics. the blog also includes reviews on makeup, hair care, niche fragrances, and some self-care.

feeds.title: Afrobella » Beauty
feeds.description: The acclaimed award winning natural hair, skincare, beauty and lifestyle blog that celebrates women all shades of beautiful. Afrobella covers everything from product reviews to unique insider celebrity, beauty and travel experiences.

feeds.title: The Style and Beauty Doctor » Beauty & Health
feeds.description: The Style and Beauty Doctor is likely the most fun and resourceful fashion and beauty guide you'll ever come across. We are not responsible for any addictions or excessive shopping resulting from browsing this site. We warned you.

feeds.title: She's Me And Her
feeds.description: What you can expect to see from She's Me And Her? Well, a bit of everything! I certainly do not discriminate when it comes to fashion - I like it all, all be it tasteful of course! From affordable yet stylish vintage, thrifted, and retail items, to a tad bit of luxurious designer items that I deem reasonable and within the budget -- if it catches my eye and within the budget, count me in! This applies to beauty products and cosmetics as well. If there's a topic relative to any of the aforementioned that piques my interest, I'd like to write about it.

feeds.title: Cole Skincare For Men Blog
feeds.description: Cole encourages black men and black women to take the initial step and invest in effective skincare products that promote skin health and total body wellness and investment is worth the time and money. My sole purpose for creating and developing Cole Skincare for Men is to represent Black Men and give them quality products they can depend on to deliver real results.

feeds.title: Nyraju Skin Care Blog
feeds.description: Get the best care for Black Skin Care, Natural Hair Care, and African American Skin Care. If you're looking for a line of natural and organic skin and hair care products that will help you have flawless, radiant skin, minimize dark spots and even your skin tone, a head of healthy hair without all the chemicals, You've come to the right place.

feeds.title: The Luxe Minimalist Blog
feeds.description: The Luxe Minimalist is a Louisiana based beauty blog featuring makeup, skincare, and hair reviews and recommendations with a focus on black women with medium-deep skin tones, combo oily skin, and kinky coily natural hair texture.

feeds.title: By Lungi » Beauty
feeds.description: ByLungi is a lifestyle and beauty blog owned and run by Lungi, a 32 year old, black woman living in Durban, South Africa. The articles on the blog cover: natural hair, beauty, travel (Africa and beyond), food and so much more!

feeds.title: Where Did You Buy That?
feeds.description: Hello, thanks for visiting my blog. I started it in 2011 because I love all aspects of fashion and I like to interpret it in my own way to suit my style and body shape. I'm a cross between an investment buyer and a bargain hunter, mixing the two, with a passion for tailor-made African print designs.

feeds.title: Black Opal Beauty Blog
feeds.description: Black Opal was created with the belief that 'beauty comes in all shades.' With unprecedented knowledge in product development, shade matching, and clinical research, our team of experts works one step ahead of the latest trends and technologies to offer an impressive range of high-intensity shades and premium-quality formulas that complement and enhance the many faces of beauty.
